systems.system: Registre numérique, biométrique et centralisé de l'état civil
systems.country_label: état civil numérique, biométrique et centralisé
systems.owner: Centre National de l'Etat Civil (CNEC), under the Interior Ministry
systems.tiers: Law provides at least one civil registry centre in each département, district, commune and arrondissement, enrolling data and transmitting it to the CNEC; their effective establishment is left to a further regulatory act
One provincial service per province, attached to the CNEC, running a provincial server with a secured connection to the CNEC

note: A statute of 15 June 2022: it provides for civil registry centres in every commune transmitting data to the national centre, but states no office as connected or working online; article 34 keeps the existing bodies (mayors, prefects) in charge until the centres are in place. The secured connection it names is the CNEC's provincial servers, not a commune office.
